editionLabel: Repos Production English Rampage rulebook, copyright 2013
firstPlayerRule: Whoever gives the most convincing giant-monster impression starts. Take turns clockwise after that.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The publisher's Terror in Meeple City page links this rulebook under the game's earlier title, Rampage.
